question:
From the given options, which two numbers should be interchanged so that the value of Y becomes 29?

6 × 4 − 5 + 9 ÷ 3 = Y
solution:
According to the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Option 1 :** 5 and 3

Given:

6 × 4 − 5 + 9 ÷ 3 = Y

After interchange the signs;

__
 
• 6 × 4 − 3 + ***9 ÷ 5__*** = Y
 
• By BODMAS rule
 
• ***__6 × 4__*** − 3 + 1.8 = Y
 
• ***__24__*** – 3 ***__+ 1.8__*** = Y
 
• 25.8 – 3 = Y
 
• 22.8 = Y<
